items.title: Starlink restrictions affecting Ukraine's front line operations, Kyiv says
items.description: Elon Musk's system allows Kyiv to protect Ukrainian skies and effectively guide drones to Russian targets.

items.title: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says
items.description: Pope Leo had a "peaceful night" in the hospital after the surgery to remove a lower lobe of his right lung, the Vatican says.

items.title: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
items.description: Four years after the attacks, Serhii K is in court accused of a plot to destroy Russia's gas pipelines to Germany.

items.title: Saudi employee charged with planting recording device in OpenAI office
items.description: Prosecutors say the device, wrapped in toilet paper, was found inserted in a USB port on the back of a TV in an executive conference room.

items.title: Turkish police raid opposition TV station, halting live broadcasts
items.description: It is the latest in a series of crackdowns on media critical of the Turkish president and his government.

items.title: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
items.description: Sir Ken McCallum says operations to tackle terrorism and state threats are now roughly of an "equal scale".

items.title: Houthi missile hits Aramco building after Saudi-led coalition hits Yemen fuel depot
items.description: The Saudi energy ministry says the Houthi attack caused a "limited fire" at Aramco's headquarters complex in Dhahran.

items.title: Trump ousts Kimberly Guilfoyle as US ambassador to Greece after corruption allegations
items.description: Guilfoyle said the allegations of improper conduct were false and that being ambassador was the "honour of a lifetime".

items.title: Ex-gang boss sentenced to 40 years for orchestrating Tupac Shakur's murder
items.description: Davis was found guilty last month over his role in the late rap superstar's death in a drive-by shooting in 1996.

items.title: Zimbabwean author denies using AI to write award-winning story
items.description: Simbarashe Kundizeza was responding to an accusation that has caused an uproar on social media.

items.title: Lena Dunham's Girls to return for limited HBO run
items.description: Ten years after the series finale, the "Girls" are getting back together to explore the "milestone of turning forty", HBO says.

items.title: Russia arrests Japanese journalist on spying charges
items.description: The Hokkaido Shimbun journalist is accused of collecting information on Moscow's defence capabilities for Tokyo.

items.title: Cornell bans all fraternity parties over gang sex assault allegations
items.description: The school has faced an uproar over how it handled assault allegations brought by a woman known as Jane Doe.

items.title: Horrified witnesses recount fatal rollercoaster incident at Six Flags
items.description: Police say preliminary information suggests the man who died at the Georgia amusement park fell from a ride.

items.title: 'I'd talk to the TV': The paid companions bringing warmth to China's lonely
items.description: As loneliness grows in China, a new industry is emerging to provide companionship and support.

items.title: Who's to blame for the toxic haze choking South East Asia?
items.description: Anger is mounting at the companies accused of burning land in Indonesia and the authorities who have failed to stop them.

items.title: Pakistan has locked down Imran Khan's stronghold - but it could backfire
items.description: Some fear the government's standoff with the former PM's supporters could bring more instability, not less.

items.title: What we know about the deadly Six Flags rollercoaster incident in Georgia
items.description: Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem died on Monday after police say he was ejected from a ride at an amusement park.

items.title: Is Zelensky right to say data centre strikes have taken down Russian bots?
items.description: Experts say there is no evidence that Russian trolls have been affected by Ukraine’s Yandex attacks.

items.title: Watch: Block of flats destroyed in Russian strikes on Ukraine
items.description: BBC Ukraine Correspondent Dan Johnson is in Kyiv, where at least three people were killed in overnight strikes.
